name: Grand Hotel Excelsior Vittoria
insider_take: Perched dramatically on clifftops overlooking the Bay of Naples, this legendary 1834 palace has hosted everyone from Wagner to Pavarotti while maintaining its aristocratic charm.
whats_special: The hotel sits on ancient Roman foundations and features original 19th-century frescoes, plus Italy's largest hotel garden with century-old palm trees. Its clifftop terrace offers unobstructed views of Mount Vesuvius across the sparkling Mediterranean.
pro_tip: Book the Caruso Suite where the legendary tenor stayed, or time your visit for the hotel's annual classical concerts in the garden amphitheater.
dont_miss: The private elevator down to Marina Piccola beach, sunset aperitivos on the Terrazza Bosquet, and the short walk to Piazza Tasso via the hotel's historic orange grove pathways.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Bay of Naples views
Historic 19th-century palace with elegant classical architecture
Prime Sorrento location within walking distance of main attractions
Luxurious amenities including spa, private beach access, and fine dining
cons: Historic building may have limited modern amenities in some rooms
